final_topology.title: Hierarchical Network Architecture
final_topology.description: A secure hierarchical network design for a government entity, including an Internet Edge, a three-tier data center, and WAN connectivity for remote sites.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes an Internet Edge zone with a firewall and application-layer security, a three-tier data center, and WAN connections to regional and branch offices. Remote sites have local routing and switching.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management' zone with an 'Asset Management System' node, which implies the presence of an asset inventory system.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation' zone with a 'Data Flow Documentation System' node, which implies the presence of a system for documenting data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' and a 'Data Center' zone, which implies that data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Server Firewall' node in the 'Data Center' zone, which implies that firewalls are implemented on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which implies that trusted DNS servers are configured.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which implies that MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which implies that DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which implies that network-based URL filters are maintained and enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (Internet Edge, Data Center, Regional Office, Branch Office, Management Zone, Non-Production Zone, External Testing Zone) and a hierarchical network design, which implies a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Tools' zone with an 'IaC Tool' node, which implies that network infrastructure is managed securely using IaC.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' node in the 'Management Zone', which implies centralized network AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which implies that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise's AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'NIDS' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which implies that a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple firewalls (Firewall, Data Center Firewall, Server Firewall) and links between zones, which implies traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' node and an 'Identity Server' node, which implies that access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Log Collection System' node in the 'Management Zone', which implies that network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' and a 'Data Center' zone, which implies that production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Host' node in the 'External Testing Zone' and a 'Penetration Testing Management System' node, which implies that periodic external penetration tests are performed.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes labeled links indicating data flows, but there is no explicit evidence of documented data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit documentation of data flows is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system and links to relevant nodes and zones.

findings_before.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes firewalls in the Internet Edge and Data Center, but there is no evidence of firewalls implemented on servers.
findings_before.missing_reason: No firewalls are shown on servers.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add firewall nodes to server nodes and link them appropriately.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various network devices, but there is no explicit evidence of secure management practices such as IaC or secure protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit secure management practices are shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes representing IaC tools and links to network devices.

findings_before.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a SIEM node, which suggests network traffic flow logs might be collected, but there is no explicit evidence of log collection.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit log collection system is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a log collection system and links to relevant network devices.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a Penetration Testing Host in the External Testing Zone, which suggests periodic external penetration tests might be performed, but there is no explicit evidence of a testing schedule or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit penetration testing process or schedule is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing management system and links to the Penetration Testing Host.
